CAMPAIGN EXPLANATION ON WEBSITE Our debut campaign, ‘I’m Sure You Know Them Too,’ invites people to rethink how they form social connections. Are they truly building new relationships, or simply uncovering ties that have always existed? It celebrates those serendipitous moments—whether during a night out with friends, a sports activity, or a casual game—when a conversation with someone new reveals they’re not a stranger after all. The realization hits: “ You lived there? You were there? Wait, you know them too?” and leaves you thinking how you hadn’t met them sooner. Our brand signature, the red band across the eyes, symbolizes that the people you’re meant to know are already within your extended social circle. And if you look closely, we’re sure you know them too ( or the friends of your friends do) . Join a world where every meaningful connection is within reach. Don’t wait. You’re just one bond away. This campaign draws a clever parallel to Instagram's "Close Friends" feature, tapping into a concept people already relate to: authencity and trust. Much like the paradoxical brilliance of Hinge’s "designed to be deleted" campaign, "Share Your Close Friends" plays with the seemingly contradictory idea of sharing something so precious—your closest connections. At its heart, this campaign emphasizes that sharing your "close friends" isn’t about losing something valuable; instead, it’s about enriching your social life. By introducing others to the people you value most, you create opportunities for new bonds, turning authencity into an even deeper network of trusted connections. The message is clear: the more connections you share, the richer and more fulfilling your social life becomes.
